description: This horizontal stacked bar chart, titled "QA-1", displays the performance breakdown of three models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—across three categories: "Correct", "Partially Correct", and an unlabeled third category represented by a light gray segment. The vertical axis lists the model names, while the horizontal axis represents performance values, shown as percentages and scaled linearly from 0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.04. Each model's performance is segmented into three colored portions: a dark purple segment for "Correct", a medium blue segment for "Partially Correct", and a light blue segment for the unlabeled category. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the values are 0.88 for "Correct", 0.08 for "Partially Correct", and 0.04 for the unlabeled category. For both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our), the values are 0.96 for "Correct", 0 for "Partially Correct", and 0.04 for the unlabeled category. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order listed on the vertical axis. The dark purple "Correct" segment is the only one with a numerical value of zero for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our), indicating no "Partially Correct" responses for those models.
